title: The Three Plundered Works and the Three Plagues
description: T42 names the three permanent works at the consummation: the new luminous ground that itself sheds light, the quenching of the fire that had belonged to self-love, and the desolation of all that had set itself in its own works — gathered into the last bolos and bound forever, with a great boundary set between this sealed mass and the soul that has come into the light. T43 names the three afflictions by which the proprium's claim is undone: the first when the proprium is taken from the midst and bound within the living principle; the second when the great fire releases, separates, and gathers inward what the proprium had hidden; the third the final separation, with male into the bolos, female into the tomb, and the firmness of confirmed stone set forever between.
